Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS) — Fully remote, Europe

Meridian Freight is building the operating system for mid-size logistics companies. We are a team of 30, remote-first across Europe.

What you will do
- Design and build REST APIs with NestJS and PostgreSQL
- Own CI/CD pipelines and container deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Work closely with the frontend team (React, Next.js)
- Mentor other engineers and review code

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience with TypeScript and Node.js
- Strong experience with NestJS and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
- Experience with automated testing (Jest) and CI/CD
- Good written English

Nice to have
- Kubernetes and Terraform
- Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ
- GraphQL

Salary: €65k–80k gross/year. Apply at https://jobs.lever.co/meridianfreight/senior-backend-engineer
